title: Chapter 168: The Fighting Power Of The Clan Elders
content:
Chapter 168: The Fighting Power Of The Clan Elders

Zerg Explosive Swarms flew through the sky from time to time, which alerted the demon army. They had witnessed the terrible power of this self-destructing army and needed to be on guard against surprise attacks at any time.

With the invisible threat of Zerg Explosive Swarms, the offensive of the demon army slowed down, allowing the under-strength Zerg Puppies to successfully hold on under the fierce attack of the demon army and wait for the return of the main force.

The Zerg Puppies gathered together again, and their strength returned to about 120,000. The Zerg Puppies, who had been under the fierce attack of the demon army, paid the price of more than 60,000 troops.

The Zerg suffered losses, which made the Naga army almost without any reduction in personnel. Their strength of about 150,000 troops did not change much.

The more than 2,000 dog demons of the demon tribe had an overwhelming advantage in size and strength compared with the Zerg Puppies, and were invincible on the battlefield.

Naga came over, and behind her were nearly 5,000 one-star Naga warriors. They picked up their bows and arrows, took out several special black iron armor-piercing heavy arrows that had not been used, and quickly shot the special heavy arrows at the dog demons fight fiercely with the Zerg puppies.

The heavy arrows of the Naga warriors penetrated the thick defense of the dog demons and shot into their bodies, causing them to howl in pain.

The fearless Zerg puppies seized the opportunity and rushed forward to encircle and kill the injured dog demons.

Some dog demons were only hit by one arrow. As long as they were not fatally shot in vital parts, they could still exert most of their strength and continue to fight with the Zerg puppies.

Some dog demons were hit by several arrows, which greatly affected their combat capabilities. If they were besieged by fierce Zerg puppies, they would soon be in danger.

The armor-piercing heavy arrows shot by Naga 妶, the elder of the Naga tribe, could penetrate the head of the dog demon from different angles, and one arrow could kill a powerful dog demon.

When she ran out of her own armor-piercing heavy arrows, she followed the Naga warriors around her and killed dozens of dog demons in a short time. Her fighting power was amazing.

Three particularly powerful giant dog demons found Naga's position. They were fighting with Zerg dogs like other dog demons. At this time, they suddenly burst out with terrible fighting power and rushed to Naga's position.

The Zerg dogs in front could not resist the charge of the three giant dog demons with increased strength. The strength of the three giant dog demons was at least three stars or above.

The flames they spewed were much more powerful than those of one-star dog demons and could cover a large area around them. This powerful flame that seemed to come from hell could burn the surrounding Zerg dogs to death in a very short time and turn them into light and disappear.

As the strength star level went up, the fire power of the dog demons also underwent a qualitative change. They were larger in size, had amazing physical attack capabilities, and had very strong physical defense capabilities. The heavy arrows of the Naga warriors could not penetrate their demon skin.

Only Naga can hurt them, but due to the upper limit of the power of bows and arrows, she cannot cause fatal damage to the three giant dog demons.

Ten Zerg Explosive Swarms in the air suddenly flew over the heads of the three dog demons, accelerated and dived down, and the three giant dog demons with keen perception spit out a piece of fire in the air.

The 10 Zerg Explosive Swarms, whose strength has not yet reached the star level, used all their strength, and finally could only get as close as possible to the three giant dog demons that were already surrounded by hellfire, and exploded at the same time.

"Boom!"

The violent explosion blew away the surrounding flames, affecting the surrounding dog demons and Zerg puppies.

Another 10 Zerg Explosive Swarms seized the opportunity and rushed over before the explosion was completely over.

"Boom!"

The two explosions were very close, and the impact waves generated by the explosions swept around, and the splashing Zerg biological decomposition liquid flew everywhere, falling on the surrounding dog demons and inferior demons, sizzling.

Even the Naga warriors who were closer were splashed with some highly corrosive Zerg biodegradation liquid. They followed closely behind the Zerg dogs. Once they were hurt, the Zerg dogs around them stretched out their limbs and sucked away the Zerg biodegradation liquid.

Even so, some Naga warriors still saw the horror of this liquid and suffered some damage.

This is why the Zerg did not send a large number of explosive mosquitoes to bomb casually. It was not because they were reluctant, but because the explosive mosquitoes could not distinguish between friend and foe.

After the explosion, the three giant dog demons at the center of the explosion were also scarred and kept spitting fire flames at each other, burning the corrosive Zerg biodegradation liquid attached to them.

The strength gap between the two sides was too obvious. The biodegradation liquid secreted by ordinary Zerg was affected by the burning of such a powerful flame, and they were all successfully shaken off to the ground.

These three giant dog demons are not only powerful, but also very experienced in combat. They have ways to deal with various attacks.

The giant dog demons that looked wounded were not seriously injured. They used themselves as arrows to lead the remaining dog demons to continue charging, and a large number of inferior demons and flame demons followed closely behind.

"Boom boom boom...!"

The fireballs of the flame demons kept flying into the Zerg puppies and the Naga army, disrupting the formation of the Zerg puppies and Naga warriors.

Faced with this situation, Naga and the Naga warriors remained unmoved and continued to calmly shoot the rushing dog demons with bows and arrows. Naga also shot a few arrows at the three giant dog demons from time to time.

The Zerg puppies in front kept rushing up, even if they could not withstand the force of the giant dog demon's attack, they had to use their bodies to block it.

From all directions, there are Zerg puppies rushing forward at the risk of their lives. They use their lives to continuously consume the fire attacks and physical strength of the three giant dog demons.

"Boom boom boom...!"

The Explosive Mosquitoes flying in the air of the Zerg began to bombard the rear phalanx of the Demon Clan army. The Queen of the Zerg accurately dropped the Explosive Mosquitoes at key positions of the Demon Clan army. A large number of Explosive Mosquitoes continued to explode, destroying the entire Demon Clan army's follow-up offensive. Everything was disrupted.

The charging dog demons and some lemures and flame demons suddenly found that the friendly forces in the rear had not followed up. Their offensive appeared on the fault line, especially the lost lemures and flame demons could not be replaced.

"Boom boom boom...!"

The Zerg Explosive Mosquitoes continued to explode, preventing the Demon Clan army from effectively gathering in the rear. A large number of Explosive Mosquitoes were put into combat and played an extremely important role.

The Zerg puppies have already rushed into the dispersed demon army, vowing to surround the dog demons rushing forward even if they are attacked from two sides.

"Continue long-range attack support!"

Nagaya ordered while shooting arrows.

This is the home ground of the Naga tribe, and there are a large number of Naga troops nearby. The arrows that some Naga warriors lack have been replenished.

They continuously launched attacks deep into the demon army's phalanx, and cooperated with the Zerg explosive mosquitoes to break up the demon army's formation, creating opportunities for the Zerg puppies that rushed into the formation.

The Zerg puppies attacked desperately, and with the help of the long-range attacks of the explosive mosquitoes and the Naga army, they finally succeeded in cutting off the retreat of the dog demons that were still charging forward, and surrounded the demon army, which numbered nearly ten thousand. .

Among the nearly 10,000 demons in the army, there are three powerful giant dog demons, and the remaining nearly a thousand one-star dog demons. The others are insignificant lemure demons and a small number of flame demons.

"Boom boom boom...!"

The Zerg Explosive Mosquitoes launched another self-destruction attack on the besieged nearly 10,000 Demon Clan troops. At this time, the Naga Clan army was already on guard and kept some distance from the Zerg Clan puppies and was not affected.

There was a big explosion and nearly 10,000 demonic troops. Except for the dog demon, all the other demons were either dead or maimed.

Seeing that the Zerg puppies were about to pounce on the dog demon again, Nagaya finally couldn't help shouting loudly: "Those three giant dog demons can't kill them like this! Get out of the way! Let me do it!"

She was just in a hurry, so she shouted to give it a try. She didn't expect that the Zerg puppy in front of her would actually make a way forward for her.

She was greatly impressed by the Zerg's battlefield command ability!

There was a road ahead. Nagaya put away her bow and arrows, picked up her sword and shield, and rushed forward!

Nagalon led the elite warriors of the Naga tribe to follow closely, passing through a large number of Zerg puppies, and finally came to the front line of the fierce battle.

The Zerg puppies were still rushing towards the three giant dog demons in groups, blocking the charge of the three giant dog demons at their own risk.

The other dog demons who survived the explosion are all being besieged by the Zerg puppies. A one-star strength dog demon can fight with a few Zerg puppies surrounding it.

There is a limit to the ability of one-star strength dog demons to spit out fire. They have been fighting with the Zerg puppies for so long, and the flames have long been exhausted.

Relying on physical combat is the strength of the Zerg puppies. From time to time, dog demons are surrounded and killed by the Zerg puppies and disappear in the form of light.

Nagaya rushed to the front line of the battle, suddenly accelerated, and like a golden lightning, she killed the three giant dog demons!

The three giant dog demons also stared at Nagaya, and three mouthfuls of terrifying hell flames sprayed over her.

The Queen of Insects carefully observed Nagaya's battle through the surrounding Zerg, and Wu Qing also observed the battle of Nagaya, a master at the elder level of the rich clan, through Host No. 3 in the air.

I saw Nagaya's body and weapons and equipment swimming at high speed, instantly bursting out with golden energy, and she passed through the fire attacks of three giant dog demons without any damage.

The golden light of the sword in her right hand flashed, and she slashed through it, and the huge head of a giant dog demon fell down!

She kept moving and continued to flash past the other two giant dog demons. The two giant dog demons didn't even have time to react, so they followed in the footsteps of their companions and their heads fell off!

Nagaya chopped off the heads of three powerful giant dog demons with just one blow, which shows the huge gap in strength between the two sides.

The death of the three giant dog demons seemed to pause for a moment before finally turning into light and disappearing. The system had to work hard to grab things, and sometimes it took some effort.

The three giant dog demons provided the system with considerable resources.

The conditions for upgrading the Zerg nest to four stars have not changed, indicating that the strength of these three giant dog demons has not yet reached the four-star level.
